name: Huma Control Center
description: Unofficial control center for the Monster Huma H4 (Uniwill PH4TUX1) on Linux: Quick Settings power mode with fine tuning and Fan Boost, on-screen display on mode and power source changes, automatic screen brightness from the ambient light measured by the camera, optional lock when nobody is at the computer, a top bar button for the Huma Control Center app and its alerts as notifications. Requires the Huma Control Center driver and services. Not affiliated with Monster Notebook or Uniwill.
